description: Experimental programme fit rubric. Use verified programme profile; do not confuse research signals with official admissions weights.

anchor_scale.1: Mostly generic interest or broad field overlap
anchor_scale.2: Specific links to relevant concepts or experience, limited explanation
anchor_scale.3: Clear understanding and demonstrated preparation tied to the programme
anchor_scale.4: Nuanced understanding, compelling evidence and credible next academic questions

criteria.name: Disciplinary understanding
criteria.guidance: Accurate grasp of central questions, practices and methods; avoid keyword matching.

criteria.name: Relevant evidence
criteria.guidance: Concrete past work that tests or develops programme-relevant abilities.

criteria.name: Academic direction
criteria.guidance: Reasonable next learning questions and links between experience and intended study.
